subject: Mobile Development
title: The App Lifecycle
description: Learn The App Lifecycle in one minute.

hook.text: Your phone shows dozens of apps in the app switcher. Most aren't actually running.

buildup.text: Apps have states: active, background, suspended, and terminated by the system.

discovery.text: When RAM runs low, the OS quietly kills suspended apps to free memory.

twist.text: Apps must save their state before suspension — or the user loses their work.

climax.text: The lifecycle system is how phones juggle dozens of apps with limited memory.

quiz.question: What happens when a phone runs low on RAM?
